versions.content: Control of DTC storage Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall support control of DTC storage via UDS service 0x85. Rationale: Avoiding unwanted storage of DTCs. Use Case: No DTCs storage when functional communication is deactivated during ECU reprogramming. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
